title: Biology: Cell Structure and Functions (Past Year Questions)

questions.q_en: Who discovered cells in the human body?
questions.solution_en: Nitially discovered by RobertHooke in 1665, the cell has a rich and interesting history that has ultimately given way to many of today's scientific advancements
questions.solution_hi: 1665 में रॉबर्ट हुक द्वारा शुरुआत में खोजी गई, कोशिका का एक समृद्ध व दिलचस्प इतिहास है जिसने अंततः आज की कई वैज्ञानिक प्रगतियों का मार्ग प्रशस्त किया।

questions.q_en: In which year did Walther Flemming coined the term 'chromatin' for the stained substance found in the cell nucleus?
questions.solution_en: On 13th January 1879, Walther Flemming was made a member of the Imperial German Academy of Natural Scientists in Halle. In the same year, he coined the term "chromatin" for the stainable substance found in the cell nucleus.
questions.solution_hi: 13 जनवरी 1879 को, वाल्थर फ्लेमिंग को हाले में इंपीरियल जर्मन एकेडमी ऑफ नेचुरल साइंटिस्ट्स का सदस्य बनाया गया। उसी वर्ष, उन्होंने कोशिका केंद्रक में पाए जाने वाले रंजित पदार्थ हेतु "क्रोमैटिन" शब्द गढ़ा।

a- appears to depict a different type of cell structure, possibly a neuron.

b- resembles a chromosome, which is unrelated to chloroplasts.

c- accurately represents a chloroplast, identifiable by its internal thylakoid stacks (grana), where light-dependent reactions of photosynthesis occur.

a- एक अलग प्रकार की कोशिका संरचना, संभवतः न्यूरॉन, दर्शाता है।

b- गुणसूत्र से मिलता-जुलता है, जो क्लोरोप्लास्ट से असंबंधित है।

questions.q_en: ______ include/s glycogen, poly-β- hydroxybutyrate granules, sulphur granules and gas vesicles.
questions.solution_en: Cytoplasm is the gelatinous liquid that fills the inside of a cell. It is composed of water, salts, and various organic molecules. Some intracellular organelles, such the nucleus and mitochondria, are enclosed by membranes that separate them from the cytoplasm.
questions.solution_hi: कोशिकाद्रव्य वह जिलेटिनी द्रव है जो कोशिका के अंदर भरा होता है। यह पानी, लवण व विभिन्न कार्बनिक अणुओं से बना है। कुछ अंतर्कोशिकीय अंगक, जैसे केंद्रक व माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया, झिल्लियों से घिरे होते हैं जो उन्हें कोशिकाद्रव्य से अलग करती हैं।

questions.q_en: Which component of cell organelles principally performs the function of packaging materials, to be delivered either to the intra-cellular targets or secreted outside the cell?
questions.solution_en: The Golgi apparatus is the principal component of cell organelles that primarily carries out the function of packaging materials, either for delivery to targets within the cell or for secretion outside the cell.
questions.solution_hi: गॉल्जी उपकरण कोशिका अंगकों का प्रमुख घटक है जो मुख्यतः पदार्थों की पैकेजिंग का कार्य करता है, चाहे कोशिका के भीतर लक्ष्यों तक पहुँचाने हेतु हो या कोशिका के बाहर स्राव हेतु।

questions.q_en: Which of the following researchers observed densely stained reticular structures surrounding the nucleus?
questions.solution_en: Camillo Golgi discovered the Golgi apparatus, a cellular organelle involved in protein and lipid processing. It appears as a densely stained reticular structure around the nucleus when viewed under a microscope.
questions.solution_hi: कैमिलो गॉल्जी ने गॉल्जी उपकरण की खोज की, एक कोशिकीय अंगक जो प्रोटीन व लिपिड प्रसंस्करण में शामिल है। यह सूक्ष्मदर्शी के तहत केंद्रक के चारों ओर एक सघन रंजित जालिकावत् संरचना के रूप में दिखाई देता है।

questions.q_en: In which year did Walter Fleming stain the chromosomes to see them clearly and describe the entire process of mitosis?
questions.solution_en:
• ​In 1882, Walther Flemming used aniline dyes to stain chromosomes, allowing him to observe and describe the process of mitosis in detail.

• Chromosomes: Thread-like structures in the cell nucleus, made of DNA and proteins, carrying genetic information; humans have 46 (23 pairs).

• Mitosis: A cell division process producing two identical daughter cells with the same chromosome number, involving prophase, metaphase, anaphase, and telophase.
questions.solution_hi:
• 1882 में, वाल्थर फ्लेमिंग ने गुणसूत्रों को रंगने हेतु एनिलिन डाई का उपयोग किया, जिससे उन्हें माइटोसिस की प्रक्रिया का विस्तार से अवलोकन व वर्णन करने में मदद मिली।

• गुणसूत्र: कोशिका केंद्रक में धागे-जैसी संरचनाएँ, DNA व प्रोटीन से बनी, आनुवंशिक जानकारी ले जाती हैं; मनुष्यों में 46 (23 जोड़े) होते हैं।

questions.q_en: In which year did Rudolf Virchow published an essay titled 'Cellular Pathology' in which he famously declared that "every cell arises from another cell"?
questions.solution_en:
Rudolf Virchow was an eminent pathologist and politician, widely regarded as one of the greatest and most influential physicians in history. A founding father of both pathology and social medicine, Virchow analyzed the effects of disease in various organs and tissues of the human body. He identified that diseases are caused by malfunctioning cells. Scientists believed imbalances in the body created blastema in which disease cells start to grow. This belief began changing in 1855 when Virchow, aged 34, published an essay in which famously he declared:

"Every cell arises from another cell."
questions.solution_hi: रूडोल्फ विरचो एक प्रतिष्ठित रोगविज्ञानी व राजनेता थे, जिन्हें व्यापक रूप से इतिहास के सबसे महान व प्रभावशाली चिकित्सकों में से एक माना जाता है। रोगविज्ञान व सामाजिक चिकित्सा दोनों के संस्थापक पिता, विरचो ने मानव शरीर के विभिन्न अंगों व ऊतकों में रोग के प्रभावों का विश्लेषण किया।

questions.q_en: Which cell organelle is defined as the small round organelle that undergoes oxidation reactions to produce hydrogen peroxide?
questions.solution_en: Peroxisomes are small, membrane-bound organelles involved in oxidation reactions that produce hydrogen peroxide as a by-product, playing a role in detoxification.
questions.solution_hi: पेरॉक्सीसोम छोटे, झिल्ली-बद्ध अंगक हैं जो ऑक्सीकरण अभिक्रियाओं में शामिल होते हैं जो उपोत्पाद के रूप में हाइड्रोजन पेरॉक्साइड उत्पन्न करते हैं, विषहरण में भूमिका निभाते हुए।

questions.q_en: How many biosphere reserves are there in India?
questions.solution_en: India has a notable count of 18 biosphere reserves within its territory. These biosphere reserves are areas designated by the government for the conservation of biodiversity while promoting sustainable development.
questions.solution_hi: भारत में इसके क्षेत्र के भीतर उल्लेखनीय रूप से 18 जैवमंडल आरक्षित क्षेत्र हैं। ये जैवमंडल आरक्षित क्षेत्र सतत विकास को बढ़ावा देते हुए जैव विविधता के संरक्षण हेतु सरकार द्वारा नामित क्षेत्र हैं।

questions.q_en: ______ is the fundamental structural unit of living organisms?
questions.solution_en:
Cells are the fundamental structural unit of living organisms.

Based on scientific observations over the next 150 years, scientists formulated the cell theory, which is used for all living organisms no matter how simple or complex. The cell theory incorporates three principles:

• Cells are the most basic building units of life.

• All living things are composed of cells.

• New cells are made from preexisting cells, which divide into two.

questions.q_en: Which of the following cell organelles possesses their own DNA and can synthesise protein for their functions?
questions.solution_en:
• Chloroplasts possess their own DNA and ribosomes, enabling them to synthesise proteins independently.

• This is a unique feature of semi-autonomous organelles like mitochondria and chloroplasts.

• Endoplasmic Reticulum: A network of membranous tubules and sacs involved in protein and lipid synthesis, and intracellular transport.

• Chloroplast: Organelles in plant cells that contain chlorophyll and are responsible for photosynthesis.

• Centrosome: A region in the cell that organizes microtubules and is involved in cell division.

• Golgi Complex: A membrane-bound organelle responsible for modifying, sorting, and packaging proteins and lipids for transport.
questions.solution_hi:

• यह माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया व क्लोरोप्लास्ट जैसे अर्ध-स्वायत्त अंगकों की एक अनूठी विशेषता है।

• अंतर्द्रव्यी जालिका: झिल्लीदार नलिकाओं व थैलियों का एक नेटवर्क जो प्रोटीन व लिपिड संश्लेषण में शामिल है।

questions.q_en: Which of the following cell organelles can make copies of themselves?
questions.solution_en:
Top of Form

Mitochondria have their own genetic material and the ability to replicate independently within the cell. This unique feature allows mitochondria to reproduce and contribute to the cellular energy production through oxidative phosphorylation.
questions.solution_hi: माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया का अपना आनुवंशिक पदार्थ होता है व कोशिका के भीतर स्वतंत्र रूप से प्रतिकृति बनाने की क्षमता होती है। यह अनूठी विशेषता माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया को प्रजनन करने व ऑक्सीडेटिव फॉस्फोरिलेशन के माध्यम से कोशिकीय ऊर्जा उत्पादन में योगदान देने में सक्षम बनाती है।

questions.q_en: Which cell organelles help in intracellular digestion and are known as the "suicidal bags" of the cell?
questions.solution_en:
The cell organelles that help in intracellular digestion and are known as the "suicidal bags" of the cell are lysosomes.

Lysosomes are spherical sacs filled with hydrolytic enzymes that can break down many types of biomolecules. They are found in animal cells and some plant cells. They digest cellular waste, foreign particles, and even damaged or old cell organelles.

questions.q_en: In cell biology, what is a large double-membraned organelle that is sometimes referred to as the 'central unit' of the cell because it contains the chromosomes that bear genetic material?
questions.solution_en:
• Nucleus is a specialized structure occurring in most cells (except bacteria and blue-green algae) and separated from the rest of the cell by a double layer, the nuclear membrane.

• In cell biology, nucleus is a large double-membraned organelle that is sometimes referred to as the 'central unit' of the cell because it contains the chromosomes that bear genetic material.

• The nucleus controls and regulates the activities of the cell (e.g., growth and metabolism) and carries the genes, structures that contain the hereditary information.

questions.q_en: Which cell theory proved that the quasi-fluid nature of lipid enables lateral movement of proteins within the overall bilayer?
questions.solution_en: The fluid mosaic hypothesis was formulated by Singer and Nicolson in the early 1970s. According to this model, membranes are made up of lipids, proteins and carbohydrates. The main lipid membrane components are phospholipids
questions.solution_hi: फ्लुइड मोज़ेक परिकल्पना सिंगर व निकोल्सन द्वारा 1970 के दशक की शुरुआत में प्रतिपादित की गई। इस मॉडल के अनुसार, झिल्लियाँ लिपिड, प्रोटीन व कार्बोहाइड्रेट से बनी होती हैं। मुख्य लिपिड झिल्ली घटक फॉस्फोलिपिड हैं।

questions.q_en: A part of the cell other than the nucleus which has DNA and ribosomes and can thus make its own proteins is known as:
questions.solution_en:
· Mitochondria are semi-autonomous organelles that contain:

o Their own DNA (mtDNA).

o Ribosomes (70S type, like prokaryotes).

o Protein-synthesis machinery to produce some of their own proteins.

· Mitochondria's bacterial-like features support the endosymbiotic theory (evolution from engulfed prokaryotes).

Further insights:

· Endoplasmic Reticulum (ER): Lacks DNA; depends on the nucleus for protein synthesis.

· Ribosomes: Protein factories but no DNA (require mRNA from the nucleus).

· Golgi Apparatus: Processes/packages proteins but cannot synthesize them independently.
questions.solution_hi:
• माइटोकॉन्ड्रिया अर्ध-स्वायत्त अंगक हैं जिनमें शामिल हैं:

o अपना DNA (mtDNA)।

o राइबोसोम (70S प्रकार, प्रोकैरियोट्स की तरह)।

o प्रोटीन-संश्लेषण तंत्र अपने कुछ प्रोटीन उत्पन्न करने हेतु।

questions.q_en: Identify the component that is unique only to prokaryotes.
questions.solution_en: • Mesosome is an extension of the cell membrane presence in cytoplasm as infolding and serves to increase the surface area in photosynthetic prokaryotes, cyanobacteria, wherein it carries the photosynthetic pigments.

questions.q_en: In animal cells, which membrane-bound cell organelles are generally smaller and help to separate waste products?
questions.solution_en:
• Vacuoles are membrane-bound organelles that can be found in both animals and plants. In a way, they're specialized lysosomes. Their function is to handle waste products. Sometimes the waste product is water, and therefore a vacuole would have as its function to maintain the balance of water inside and outside a cell.

• Sometimes a vacuole's function is to get rid of harmful toxins or to clear the extracellular space of those harmful toxins by bringing them into the cell for conversion; for chemical conversion into more safe compounds.
questions.solution_hi: • रिक्तिकाएँ झिल्ली-बद्ध अंगक हैं जो जंतुओं व पौधों दोनों में पाई जा सकती हैं। एक तरह से, ये विशिष्ट लाइसोसोम हैं। इनका कार्य अपशिष्ट उत्पादों को संभालना है। कभी-कभी अपशिष्ट उत्पाद पानी होता है, अतः रिक्तिका का कार्य कोशिका के अंदर व बाहर पानी का संतुलन बनाए रखना होगा।

questions.q_en: What is the jelly like substance between the nucleus and the cell membrane called?
questions.solution_en: The jelly-like substance known as cytoplasm occupies the region between the cell membrane and the nucleus in a cell.
